# Fixture kernel (negative control: every kept token resolves)

Run a `Widget` through the `gadgets` stage (plural folds to Gadget), then
`br-like` aliases resolve, and `parse_it` is an allowlisted code identifier.

Dropped by the shape: `path/to/file`, `file.md`, `--flag`, `key: value`,
`call()`, `/command`, `two words`.

```
`InsideFence` is ignored because it sits in fenced code.
```
